responses: I can guide you first. If the issue still needs a person, use the support page for the relevant order or account.

intents.next_step: Next step: choose damaged item as the return reason.

responses: If the order has not shipped, update the address from your orders page. If it has shipped, contact support.

responses: I can help start a return. If you have the order number, type it now; otherwise open your orders page and choose the item to return.
For returns, choose the order and item first, then select the reason such as damaged, wrong item, or no longer needed.
Return help starts from the orders page. Type an order number if you want this chat to focus on a specific order.
I can help with delivery changes or problems. Tell me if it is late, missing, damaged, wrong address, or type the order number.
I can help track an order. Please type the order number, for example: 123456.
Please share the order number so I can keep this tracking request focused.
For order tracking, type the order number and I will guide the next step.
Order {order_number} is selected for this conversation. You can ask to track it, return it, cancel it, or check delivery help.
Order {order_number} is selected for tracking. Check the tracking page for carrier status, delivery date, and proof of delivery.
I have order {order_number} for tracking. Open your orders page and choose Track Package for the latest delivery update.
Order {order_number} is selected for return help. Open the order, choose the item, and start a return or replacement request.
For order {order_number}, start from your orders page, select the item, and choose the return reason that matches the problem.
Order {order_number} is selected for delivery help. If it has not shipped, update the address or delivery option from the order page.
For order {order_number}, check the delivery status first. If it has shipped, use order support for address or delivery-date changes.
Order {order_number} is selected for payment help. Compare the order total with the completed payment and keep the transaction ID ready.

Order {order_number} is ready to track from your orders page.
For order {order_number}, open the tracking page to see the latest update.

responses: For order {order_number}, open your orders page, choose the item, and start a return or replacement request.
You can start a return for order {order_number} from your orders page if the item is eligible.
intents.next_step: Next step: choose the item and return reason on your orders page.

responses: For order {order_number}, use the cancel option on your orders page if it has not shipped yet.
You may be able to cancel order {order_number} before dispatch. If it has shipped, you may need to return it.
intents.next_step: Next step: use the cancel option before the order ships, if available.

responses: You can cancel an order before it ships from your orders page if the cancel option is available.
If the cancel option is missing, the order is probably already being prepared or shipped.
For cancellation, check your orders page as soon as possible because the option is time-sensitive.

That looks like a duplicate payment. Do not retry checkout. First check whether one transaction is pending. If both payments are completed, keep the order number and transaction IDs and raise a payment refund request from the order or billing page.

For a payment made twice, check your bank statement first. If one charge is pending, wait for it to clear. If two completed charges remain, report the duplicate payment with your order number and transaction details.
intents.next_step: Next step: save a screenshot of both completed charges before reporting it.

responses: Please tell me which payment issue happened: failed checkout, declined card, wrong charge, duplicate charge, or type the order number.
I can help with payment problems. Was it failed, declined, charged incorrectly, charged twice, or linked to a specific order?
For payment help, share whether it is checkout failure, card decline, duplicate charge, wrong charge, or an order number.
For password help, use the password reset option on the sign-in page, confirm the email address, and follow the verification link.
If you cannot sign in, reset the password first. If the account is locked, complete the verification steps shown on the sign-in page.
intents.next_step: Next step: check your email for the reset or verification message.

responses: I can help with account access. Tell me if the issue is login, password, email, profile, or a locked account.
For account help, share whether you need password reset, login support, email change, or account recovery.
Account support covers login, password, email, profile, and locked-account problems.
What matters most for the item: price, rating, delivery speed, or brand?
For price-focused shopping, sort by price, compare ratings, and check delivery fees before choosing.
intents.next_step: Next step: shortlist two or three items before deciding.

responses: For review-focused shopping, compare recent verified reviews, rating count, and product photos.
intents.next_step: Next step: read recent verified reviews.

responses: For fast delivery, filter by delivery date and check whether the item is ready to ship from your area.
Choose items with clear delivery dates and avoid listings with uncertain dispatch times.
intents.next_step: Next step: filter by delivery date before choosing.

responses: For brand-focused shopping, compare official stores, seller ratings, warranty details, and return policy.
Choose trusted sellers with clear warranty, return, and support information.
intents.next_step: Next step: compare seller rating, warranty, and return policy.

responses: For offers, check the deals page, coupons, and limited-time discounts before checkout.
Some discounts apply automatically, while coupon discounts must be selected before checkout.
If a promo code is not working, check the expiry date, eligible items, and minimum order value.
Membership benefits can include faster delivery, special offers, or other services depending on the store.
You can usually manage membership from your account settings or subscriptions page.
If a membership benefit is missing, check whether the membership is active and whether the item is eligible.
If the seller is not responding, open the order page and use the order support option so the platform can review the case.
For a missing seller reply, keep the order details ready and raise the issue from the order support page.
I can help with seller issues. Tell me if the seller is not responding, the listing looks fake, or there is an order dispute.
For seller help, open the order page first. If the seller is not responding, use the order support option so the case can be reviewed.
Seller support can help with marketplace disputes, missing replies, listing concerns, and seller-related order problems.

If tracking has no update, check the promised delivery date first. If that date has passed, contact support with the order number and latest carrier status.
A tracking page can pause while the package moves between facilities. If the delivery date has passed, raise a missing or delayed package request from the order page.
intents.next_step: Next step: keep the order number and latest tracking status ready.

responses: Return policy depends on the item category, seller, and delivery date. Check the return window on the order page before starting the request.
For return policy, open the order details and confirm whether the item is still inside the return window and whether it needs original packaging.
intents.next_step: Next step: check the return window on the order page.

responses: For a return label, open the return request and choose the drop-off or pickup option shown for that item.
Return label options appear after the return reason is selected. Use the label or QR code shown on the return page.
intents.next_step: Next step: choose the return method shown on the order page.

responses: Refund timing depends on the payment method and when the returned item is received. Check the refund status from the order or payment page.
If the return has been received but the refund is delayed, keep the order number and refund reference ready before contacting support.
intents.next_step: Next step: check the refund status on the order page.

responses: If rescheduling is available, the order tracking page will show a delivery date or time-slot option. If the package is already out for delivery, contact support.
Delivery date changes depend on the carrier status. Check the tracking page first and use the reschedule option if it appears.
intents.next_step: Next step: check whether the tracking page shows a reschedule option.

responses: If payment failed, do not retry repeatedly. Check card details, billing address, available balance, and whether the bank blocked the transaction.
A failed checkout can happen because of bank checks, expired cards, billing mismatch, or temporary checkout errors.
intents.next_step: Next step: verify billing details before trying again.

responses: If the card was declined, confirm the card is active, billing details match, and online transactions are allowed by the bank.
A declined card usually needs bank confirmation or updated billing details before checkout will work.
intents.next_step: Next step: check the bank message or try another saved payment method.

responses: For a wrong charge, compare the order total, delivery fee, discount, and bank transaction amount. Keep a screenshot before reporting it.
If the charge does not match the order total, open the billing details and report the transaction with the order number.
intents.next_step: Next step: save the transaction ID and order total before contacting support.

responses: For email changes, open account settings and update the email address after verification. If you cannot access the old email, use account recovery.
Email changes usually require verification. Check both the old and new inbox for confirmation messages.
intents.next_step: Next step: verify the new email from account settings.

responses: For buying decisions, check the item return window, warranty details, seller rating, and support information before checkout.
A safer product choice has a clear return window, visible warranty terms, recent reviews, and a reliable seller profile.
intents.next_step: Next step: open the item details and confirm the return window before buying.

responses: For seller policy, check seller rating, return terms, warranty coverage, and how quickly the seller responds to customers.
Before buying from a seller, review their rating, return policy, warranty information, and recent buyer feedback.
intents.next_step: Next step: compare seller rating and return terms before checkout.

responses: If a listing looks fake, avoid checkout. Check seller history, product reviews, price realism, and whether the brand or warranty looks genuine.
For a suspicious seller, do not share extra personal details. Report the listing and choose a seller with stronger ratings and verified reviews.
intents.next_step: Next step: report the listing if the seller or product details look unsafe.

responses: Proof of delivery is usually shown on the tracking page after the package is marked delivered. Open the order, choose Track Package, and check for a delivery photo, signed confirmation, or delivery note.
To check proof of delivery, open the order tracking page and look below the delivered status for a photo, signature, or carrier delivery note.
intents.next_step: Next step: open Track Package for the selected order and review the delivered status details.

responses: Carrier status shows where the package is in the delivery process. Open Track Package to see the latest scan, courier name, and current delivery stage.
For carrier status, check the tracking page first. If the carrier has not updated after the promised delivery date, contact support with the order number.
intents.next_step: Next step: compare the latest carrier scan with the promised delivery date.

responses: The delivery date is shown on the order tracking page. If the date has changed, use the latest date shown by the carrier before contacting support.
To check the delivery date, open Track Package for the order and read the expected delivery section near the current carrier status.
intents.next_step: Next step: use the latest expected date shown on the tracking page.

responses: To open the tracking page, go to your orders page, select the order, and choose Track Package. That page shows carrier status, delivery date, and delivery proof when available.
Track Package is the main page for order movement, carrier updates, expected delivery date, and delivery proof after delivery.
intents.next_step: Next step: open the selected order and choose Track Package.

responses: For seller rating, choose sellers with strong recent ratings, verified reviews, clear return terms, and visible warranty support.
Seller rating helps compare reliability. Prefer sellers with consistent ratings, recent feedback, and clear support information.
intents.next_step: Next step: compare recent seller feedback before checkout.
